select pa.*,g.goods_name,s.supplier_name,u.nick_name from sale_return as pa inner join goods as g on g.goods_id = pa.goods_id inner join supplier as s on s.supplier_id = g.supplier_id inner join sys_user as u on u.user_id = pa.create_user where 1=1
and g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.goodsName},'%')
and s.supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.supplierName},'%')
and u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{parm.nickName},'%')
order by pa.create_time desc
